description: A sitemap artifact is valid when it declares every screen in the product as a node with a unique ID, a valid route, a parent reference forming a DAG, and explicit visibility for all auth-gated screens.

rules.description: sitemap-spec.json must contain a non-empty nodes array. An empty sitemap cannot describe any product structure.
Every node must have id (string, non-empty), label (string, non-empty), and route (string, non-empty). These three fields are the minimum for any downstream compiler to resolve a screen reference.
All node ids must be unique within the sitemap. Duplicate ids cause ambiguous cross-references in navigation-graph and user-flow compilers.
Every non-root node (parent is not null/undefined) must reference a parent id that exists in the node list. Dangling parent references produce orphan nodes.
Following parent references from any node must not produce a cycle. A cyclic sitemap cannot be rendered as a tree or navigated with stack-based routing.
When declared, visibility must be 'public', 'authenticated', or a non-empty role string. Empty or null visibility on an auth-required node creates a security ambiguity.
Nodes with auth=true must declare visibility as 'authenticated' or a named role. auth=true with visibility='public' is a contract violation — it signals an access-control mismatch.
All non-planned routes must start with '/' and use valid URL path characters. Routes that do not start with '/' cannot be used by frontend routers.
Non-planned nodes must not share the same route. Duplicate routes cause router ambiguity and undefined navigation behavior.
At least one node must represent the 404/not-found screen, or notFoundHandledExternally must be set to true. Absence of a not-found screen leaves a gap in the navigation contract.
Root-level nodes (parent=null) must not exceed maxRootNodes (default 10). Excessive root-level items indicate a flat, ungrouped information architecture.
sitemap-spec.json must declare a version string. Version enables change detection and migration across sitemap iterations.
